Footballer Julian Alvarez Misses Training Amid Transfer Speculation

Julian Alvarez, a target for FC Barcelona and potentially Arsenal, missed Atletico Madrid training. Reports suggest Alvarez is experiencing depression, according to COPE. Meanwhile, Atletico Madrid is reportedly in talks to sign Juventus striker Jonathan David as a potential replacement. Other reports indicate Arsenal may be on alert for Alvarez's transfer, with the club confirming "triple transfer" deals before a deadline. Separately, West Ham United announced their seventh summer signing.
